skill.name: obsidian-vault
skill.description: Search, create, and organize notes in a local Obsidian vault using Markdown files, wikilinks, and index notes.
skill.summary: Manage Obsidian vault notes with search workflows, wikilinks, and index note conventions.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and code fences. Three findings are confirmed because the skill instructs use of local find and grep commands against an Obsidian vault, which can read filenames and note contents.

remediation.issue: External command examples read local vault data.
remediation.suggestion: State that commands should run only after user approval and only against the user-selected vault path.

remediation.issue: The vault path is hardcoded to one local Windows mount location.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the fixed path with a configurable vault path supplied by the user.

remediation.issue: Search terms are shown as shell command placeholders.
remediation.suggestion: Tell agents to pass search terms as literal arguments or use safer Grep and Glob tools.

content.value_statement: Large Obsidian vaults are hard to search and connect consistently. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear workflows for note search, creation, and linking.
actual_capabilities: Locate Markdown notes by filename using vault search commands.
Search note contents for keywords inside the vault.
Create new notes with title case filenames.
Add Obsidian wikilinks to related notes.
Find backlinks by searching for wikilink references.
Identify index notes by filename patterns.
limitations: The skill assumes a specific local vault path.
It does not include an Obsidian plugin or API integration.
It depends on local file access and command-line search tools.
It does not validate note content quality or link accuracy automatically.

use_cases.title: Find Research Notes
use_cases.description: Search filenames and note contents to locate relevant Markdown notes in a local vault.

use_cases.title: Create Linked Notes
use_cases.description: Draft new learning notes with title case names and related Obsidian wikilinks.

use_cases.title: Maintain Index Notes
use_cases.description: Find index notes and add links that group related topics for easier navigation.

prompt_templates.title: Search for a Note
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner search by topic or filename.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my Obsidian vault for notes related to {topic}. Show likely matches and why each is relevant.

prompt_templates.title: Find Backlinks
prompt_templates.prompt: Find notes that link to [[{note_title}]]. Summarize the backlink context for each result.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Connected Note
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a new note titled {note_title}. Include concise content and add wikilinks to related notes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve an Index
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced organization across a topic area.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review index notes for {topic}. Suggest missing links, duplicate coverage, and a cleaner index structure.

output_examples.input: Find notes about retrieval augmented generation.
output: Likely matches include RAG Index, Vector Search, and Embeddings Overview.
The RAG Index note should be the starting point because it groups related topics.

output_examples.input: Create a note about prompt evaluation.
output: Created Prompt Evaluation with a concise explanation and related links.
Added wikilinks to Evaluation Datasets, LLM Testing, and Prompt Engineering.
Found notes that reference Skills Index by wikilink.
Several backlinks appear in tool notes and workflow notes that discuss skill organization.

best_practices: Confirm the vault path before reading or editing notes.
Use exact note titles when creating wikilinks.
Review proposed note edits before applying them to important vaults.
anti_patterns: Do not run searches outside the intended vault path.
Do not create duplicate notes without checking existing filenames.
Do not add broad index links that are unrelated to the note topic.

faq.question: Does this skill require Obsidian to be open?
faq.answer: No. It works with Markdown files in the local vault path.

faq.question: Can it manage vaults in other folders?
faq.answer: Yes, if the assistant is given the correct vault path and file access.

faq.question: Can it create new notes?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create title case Markdown notes and add related wikilinks.

faq.question: Can it find backlinks?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches for Obsidian wikilink references to a note title.

faq.question: Does it use the Obsidian application API?
faq.answer: No. It uses local file search and Markdown conventions.

faq.question: Is it safe for private notes?
faq.answer: Use it only with trusted assistants and confirm commands before reading sensitive vault content.
